description: Header file defining classes and functions for Vault management and cryptography, including Vault and VaultNetflix classes, with external dependencies on security and core modules.

classes.name: Vault
classes.description: Manages cryptographic vault operations, including size, import/export, put/get, delete, and IPersistent APIs.

classes.name: VaultNetflix
classes.description: Specialized vault class for Netflix-related cryptographic key management, extending Vault with additional key handling and ESN functions.

methods.name: NetflixInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of Vault or VaultNetflix.

methods.name: getSecProcHandle
methods.description: Returns the security processor handle.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns size of stored item by ID.

methods.name: Import
methods.description: Imports a blob into the vault.

methods.name: Export
methods.description: Exports a stored item by ID.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Stores a blob into the vault.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a stored blob by ID.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes an item by ID.

methods.name: ImportNamedKey
methods.description: Imports a named key from a file.

methods.name: CreateNamedKey
methods.description: Creates a new named key.

methods.name: CheckNamedKey
methods.description: Checks existence of a named key.

methods.name: ProcessorRelease
methods.description: Releases the cryptographic processor.

methods.name: ESN
methods.description: Retrieves the ESN (Electronic Serial Number).

methods.name: GetNamedKey
methods.description: Retrieves a named key handle.

methods.name: AddKey
methods.description: Adds a key to the internal map.

methods.name: DeleteKeyFromMap
methods.description: Deletes a key from the internal map.

methods.name: GetNewKeyHandle
methods.description: Generates a new key handle.

methods.name: getKeyInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a key handle.

methods.name: deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key handle.

methods.name: FindKey
methods.description: Finds a key handle by ID.

methods.name: esn
methods.description: Returns the ESN string.

methods.name: FindNamedKey
methods.description: Finds a key handle by name.
